newsitem.title: USA: Eastern Co urged to seek proposals for sale.
newsitem.headline: Eastern Co urged to seek proposals for sale.

text.p: A member of a group that made an unsuccessful takeover bid for Eastern Co and continues battle the company in court said on Tuesday he would propose that Eastern take steps to seek proposals for its sale.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, a group that includes Millbrook Capital Management said the proposal by one of its members, Ernest Ohnell, would be presented to shareholders at the company's 1997 meeting.

A November 20 letter to Eastern from Ohnell, who said he holds 52,050 shares, asks the company to include in its proxy materials his proposal to retain an investment banking firm to seek proposals for the sale of the company "to maximize shareholder value."
The proposal would be non-binding on the board, he said.

"However, a substantial shareholder vote in favor should, in my opinion, be regarded as a mandate to the board to develop a program to truly maximize value for shareholders," he said in proposed statement intended for shareholders.
